concept_zh: 主线场景生命周期状态机（Merge must be reversible）
concept_en: Mainline scenario lifecycle state machine (Merge must be reversible)
audit_principle_zh: 审计独立：运营方不能为自己上线的红利自己签字；退场判断由具名维护者、独立评估者与受影响公众共同复核。
audit_principle_en: Audit independence: an operator cannot sign off its own live dividend; exit decisions must be co-reviewed by a named maintainer, an independent assessor, and affected public parties.

transitions.condition: open proposal submitted; issue→PR→review flow public
no-AI baseline proven (C2 pass); C0-C4 pass
C5 gray live authorized; rollback ready
scheduled or forced unplug; cannot be skipped
exit dividend usable + maintenance responsible party + public audit (retained cannot be skipped)
no usable dividend; archive failure and decision

stop_channels_zh: 纸面、电话、有人柜台与现场可逆闸共同构成停止通道，确保拔线不是单向的、由技术方单方面决定。
